title: 第2252章 第九层禁制第2251章 血色巨龙
content_zh:
“算了，到时候再研究吧。”叶无尘将葫芦收入储物戒中，不打算继续耗下去了。
“既然这一层没有考验，那便去下一层看看吧。”
如此想着，叶无尘便打算直接朝着青冥塔的第九层走去，可当他走到踏入第九层的光门前，却是有一道无形的屏障挡在了他面前，让他无法再前进一步。
“禁制？”叶无尘眉头微皱，神魂之力涌出，试图感知这道禁制的强度。
片刻后，他的脸上露出一丝无奈之色。
这道禁制的强度极高，而且设下禁制之人的修为远超于他，以他如今的实力，根本无法强行破开。
“青冥塔第九层，仙尊刻入。”
一道古老的声音直接在叶无尘脑海中响起，使得叶无尘脸上露出了几分无奈之色。
“仙尊境么……”
他如今的修为只是仙境高阶，距离仙尊境还有一段距离。
虽然他自信以他如今的实力，足以与仙尊巅峰的强者一战，但修为境界这种东西，做不得假。
仙尊境就是仙尊境，仙境就是仙境，这道禁制只认修为，不认实力。
“看来，只能等突破到仙尊境再来了。”叶无尘轻声自语，转身走下阶梯。
虽然他没能进入第九层，但这一趟青冥塔之行，他的收获已经足够丰厚了。
塔门前，那位白发苍苍的老者依旧盘坐在古树下，双眼微闭，仿佛从未动过。
叶无尘朝着那老者拱了拱手，对方没有任何反应，他也不在意，直接离开了此地。
从青冥塔返回之后，他便直接回到了自己的住处，直接打坐修行。
从青冥塔出来之后，他的修为便已经来到了仙境高阶巅峰，距离仙境巅峰只有一步之遥，此刻自然是要在最短的时间内突破。
时间缓缓流逝，不知过了多久，他体内忽然传来一道轻微的闷响，如同打破了一层无形的屏障。
叶无尘睁开眼睛，那双深邃的眸子中闪过一丝精芒。

仙境巅峰。
此刻的他，距离重回仙尊境只剩下最后一步了。
简单休息了一会，叶无尘便走出了院落，只因今日是青山宗藏书阁对外门弟子开放的日子，他正好想去看看，九域界的一些神通，与玄荒仙域的神通有何区别。
一座磅礴大气的楼阁前，叶无尘停下了脚步。
青山宗的藏经阁自成一界，很是广阔，一排排书架上摆满了古卷，皆都是青山宗自建立以来收集到的神通。
看守藏经阁的是一位身材佝偻的老头，头发花白，名为黄云。
“长老，我来翻阅藏经阁的神通。”叶无尘拱手打了声招呼。
“进去吧，切记不能私自将那些神通术法拓印下来。”黄云长老上下打量了叶无尘几眼，提醒道。
叶无尘点了点头，随即便迈步走了进去。
藏经阁内人并不算多，叶无尘一边走，一边翻阅那些古卷，一本本古卷被他拿下来，翻看了几眼之后又放了回去。
好几个时辰过去，他都没能找到一本让他眼前一亮的神通。
“看到了那些稍微强大一点的神通功法，都在藏经阁的上面几层。”叶无尘沉吟道。
content_en:
"Forget it, let's study it later." Ye Wuchen put the gourd into the storage ring, not planning to consume it any more.
"Since there is no test on this level, let's go to the next level and have a look."
Thinking like this, Ye Wuchen planned to walk directly towards the ninth floor of Qingming Tower, but when he walked to the light door entering the ninth floor, there was an invisible barrier blocking him, preventing him from taking another step forward.
"Restriction?" Ye Wuchen frowned slightly, and the power of his soul surged out, trying to sense the strength of this restriction.
After a moment, a look of helplessness appeared on his face.
The strength of this restriction is extremely high, and the cultivation level of the person who set it up is far beyond his. With his current strength, he cannot forcefully break it.
"On the ninth floor of Qingming Pagoda, the Immortal Lord is carved into it."
An ancient voice sounded directly in Ye Wuchen's mind, causing a look of helplessness on Ye Wuchen's face.
"Is it the Immortal Realm..."
His current cultivation level is only at the high level of the Immortal Realm, and he is still far away from the Immortal Realm.
Although he is confident that with his current strength, he is enough to fight against a strong person at the peak of the Immortal Lord, the realm of cultivation cannot be faked.
The Immortal Realm is the Immortal Realm, and the Immortal Realm is the Immortal Realm. This restriction only recognizes cultivation, not strength.
"It seems that we can only wait until we break through to the Immortal Realm before coming back." Ye Wuchen whispered to himself, turned around and walked down the stairs.
Although he failed to enter the ninth floor, his harvest from this trip to Qingming Tower was already rich enough.
In front of the tower gate, the white-haired old man was still sitting cross-legged under the ancient tree, his eyes slightly closed, as if he had never moved.
Ye Wuchen cupped his hands towards the old man, but there was no reaction from the other party. He didn't care and left the place directly.
After returning from Qingming Pagoda, he went directly back to his residence and meditated directly.
After coming out of Qingming Pagoda, his cultivation has reached the high-level peak of the fairyland. He is only one step away from the peak of the fairyland. At this moment, he naturally has to break through in the shortest time.
Time passed slowly. I don't know how long it took, but a slight muffled sound suddenly came from his body, as if an invisible barrier had been broken.
Ye Wuchen opened his eyes, and a glimmer of light flashed in his deep eyes.
The pinnacle of wonderland.
At this moment, he is only one step away from returning to the Immortal Realm.
After a brief rest, Ye Wuchen walked out of the courtyard. Because today was the day when the Qingshan Sect's library was open to outer disciples, he just wanted to see how the magical powers of the Nine Realms differed from those of the Xuanhuang Immortal Realm.
In front of a majestic pavilion, Ye Wuchen stopped.
The Scripture Collection Pavilion of the Qingshan Sect is a world of its own and is very vast. Rows of bookshelves are filled with ancient scrolls, all of which are magical powers collected by the Qingshan Sect since its establishment.
The person guarding the Sutra Pavilion is a stooped old man with gray hair named Huang Yun.
"Elder, I'm here to look through the magical powers of the Sutra Pavilion." Ye Wuchen said hello with his hands in hand.
"Go in, remember not to imprint those magical powers without permission." Elder Huang Yun looked at Ye Wuchen up and down and reminded him.
Ye Wuchen nodded and then stepped in.
There were not many people in the Scripture Pavilion. As Ye Wuchen walked, he flipped through the ancient scrolls. He took down each ancient scroll, looked at it for a few times and then put it back.
Several hours passed, but he still couldn't find a magical book that made his eyes shine.
"I saw those slightly more powerful supernatural powers and techniques, they are all on the upper floors of the Sutra Pavilion." Ye Wuchen muttered.
